name: Long Time No See
source:
After a year apart, three friends reunite to spend a stormy Halloween night together in a haunted house. When they cross paths with a little ghost, they embark on an adventure that will test the strength of their friendship.

[Fom [url=https://incredulous.itch.io/long-time-no-see]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
分別一年後，三個朋友再度相聚，來到一棟鬧鬼的房子，共度風雨交加的萬聖夜。與一個小幽靈的不期而遇，帶他們踏上了一場考驗友情的冒險。

［摘自[url=https://incredulous.itch.io/long-time-no-see]itch.io[/url]］
